integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Finite enumeration in the accompanying verifier is corroborative only and is not used to establish the statement for arbitrary \(N\).
scientific_limitations: The bound is not claimed globally tight. It inherits the anchor's local covariance estimates and its separate odd/even matching recombination; it applies to even periodic spin-\(1/2\) chains and the total nearest-neighbour vector-chirality generator. The strict improvement occurs only for \(k>N/2\).
title: A global matching-cut sharpening of the vector-chirality QFI witness
